APIs for generating QUIC ACK frames and managing queued ACK ranges.

# Purpose
This header file defines the data types and APIs used to build and send QUIC ACK frames. It declares `fd_quic_ack_t` to store one ACK range and `fd_quic_ack_gen_t` to track queued ACK data, delayed ACK state, and the ring buffer used to cache generated ACK frames. The file also provides the [`fd_quic_ack_gen_init`](<#fd_quic_ack_gen_init>) inline initializer, packet queueing with [`fd_quic_ack_pkt`](<#fd_quic_ack_pkt>), queue access with [`fd_quic_ack_queue_ele`](<#fd_quic_ack_queue_ele>), ACK discard by encryption level with [`fd_quic_ack_gen_abandon_enc_level`](<#fd_quic_ack_gen_abandon_enc_level>), and frame encoding with [`fd_quic_gen_ack_frames`](<#fd_quic_gen_ack_frames>). It also defines ACK queue size limits and return codes that describe the result of ACK queue updates.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_quic_ack_pkt`
- `fd_quic_ack_gen_abandon_enc_level`
- `fd_quic_gen_ack_frames`
